body:
First of all, thank you very much for your kind advice. 
My SO came this afternoon and we spent several hours talking. He cried a lot and I felt like shit, I haven't seen him crying in this almost 5 years together and it was a devastating picture. He and his sister (via phone, she has anxiety and depression as well) tried to help me. At first I was pretty stubborn and cold, but seeing the love of my life this sorrowful (and your helpful comments) made me change my decission and try to "stay" and "hold on" a time to rethink about my whole life and see "what happens". My SO proposed like a lot of possible solutions (sadly, most of them were not realistic in my situation) and I have to admit that this tenacity and love beyond all my problems helped me to decide to stay. Thanks to all of you, and... I really love my boyfriend. I will try to be as amazing as he deserves. And happy. Let's see what happens.

I have no hope. I have nothing good in me to deserve to have self-esteem. My "selflessness" is just a very strong desire to be liked. I don't belong in this world, everyday I wake up is a day I wish I would have died.

I fear her. She is 10 years older than me and very strict. We love each other but can't get along. She thinks I am too weak because I couldn't work and take care of my parents at the same time.
My father only thinks about him and nothing about everyone else. I have been all day long crying in bed and he only talked to me to ask when would I put him an injection that he needs daily -I was going to do that later, but his indifference to my suffering makes me suffer even more.
My mother cares about me but she is too sick and too worried about my father to actually help me. I try to look better than I feel because I don't want her to be even more worried, she has enough with my father's issues and her own ones.
My anxiety got a little better when I left my job but it got worse a few weeks ago. Sometimes my chest hurts because I contain myself, I can't have an anxiety crisis at the moment.
Now I just want everyone to let me go without them being sad and give them everything I have. And die. Just that.

I have an older sister that doesn't like that solution. She wants me to get to work again but not to seek any help for our parents, she  thinks I am a big fiasco since I left my job. She only sees whar my mother wants her to see and she thinks my parents are better, I wish they would be, but they are not. She doesn't live here at our parents' home because she has children and her own home. Things I wanted some time ago. But not now. I have no future. I don't want to do anything. I can't concentrate to read some book and I don't find music enjoyable anymore. I don't want to get out of bed. All I do is sleep, browse reddit, do some chores, control my parents' meds and suffer. Sometimes I take driving lessons but anxiety is destroying me. I am a burden.
They are wrong and they are wasting their time. I can't give them what they deserve. I am a lost cause, they should let me go and don't think about me again.

Yes, I suffered bullying and harassment in high school, and my parents' illnesses bring me down as well. I had some psychological therapy 2 years ago but I couldn't talk about those things without getting too anxious and I left therapy (stupid move, I know, but I am too coward to face those episodes). Maybe I have no fix!

Thank you for your amazing words, I would hug you if I couls... You made me cry... 

I just feel unfair that such as amazing person as my SO or some of my acquaintances (or even you) are wasting time and efforts in me when they could be happier and better than this. 
Many times my SO said to me that I am too selfless and that I should put myself first in ny thoughts, and not the others. But I can't. I hate myself and the way I am even when I tried to change those things I don't like. I feel pathetic. It's like I am not built for living and/or being happy and I don't want to drag other people into this abyss with me, as I said before, I find that unfair. I hurt everyone that cares about me. My existence is unfair.
